title: schoenia ramosissima
intro: Schoenia ramosissima, commonly known as woolly heads or woolly daisy, is a flowering plant species native to Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenia ramosissima include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
